definitions.explanation: Western countries collectively, including Europe and North America.

examples.japanese: {欧米|おうべい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {欧米|おうべい} is a common abbreviation combining ⟦{欧州|おうしゅう}→欧州：13186_oushuu⟧ (Europe) and ⟦{米国|べいこく}→米国：19596_beikoku⟧ (America).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {欧米|おうべい}⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧ (Western countries)
- {欧米|おうべい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (Western culture)
- {欧米|おうべい}⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (Westerners)
- {欧米|おうべい}⟦{風|ふう}→風：noentry⟧ (Western-style)

ETYMOLOGY:
- {欧|おう} = Europe (⟦{欧州|おうしゅう}→欧州：13186_oushuu⟧)
- {米|べい} = America (⟦{米国|べいこく}→米国：19596_beikoku⟧)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧ - the West (broader term)
- ⟦{東洋|とうよう}→東洋：03454_touyou⟧ - the East (contrast)
